name: nexus_search_mods
description:
Search Nexus mods by name with free text + filters, sorted and paginated [via v2] [v2 - no v1 quota].
v1 has no free-text search, so this is the only way to search by name.

Returns:
    JSON {totalCount, _returned, nodes: [{modId, uid, name, summary, author,
    version, downloads, endorsements, fileSize, game, modCategory, uploader,
    pictureUrl, ...}]}. Paginate with offset += _returned until
    offset >= totalCount. Note: description (full BBCode) is NOT included
    here - use nexus_get_mod_v2 for full mod details.

count.description: Results per page. Server silently caps page size (~50-80); check '_returned'.
count.title: Count

domain_name.description: Nexus Mods game domain (lowercase URL slug), e.g. 'forzahorizon6', 'skyrimse'. NOT the display name.
domain_name.title: Domain Name

exclude_adult.description: If true, exclude adult-content mods from results.
exclude_adult.title: Exclude Adult

min_downloads.description: Only mods with at least this many downloads.
min_downloads.title: Min Downloads

min_endorsements.description: Only mods with at least this many endorsements.
min_endorsements.title: Min Endorsements

sort.description: Sort key - see enum values below; only one key is exposed.
sort.title: Sort

term.description: Free-text term matched against mod names (wildcard match). Optional.
term.title: Term
